Loss report: argo -> woodpecker

[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider argo (dependency, eventSource, sensor, trigger) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)

[external] pipeline/ci/job/deploy job.if: pull request test (Woodpecker holds the target branch in CI_COMMIT_BRANCH on a pull request, so the condition gains a pull request test; the source condition is kept in a marker)
